text:
maria gonzalez: Quick heads-up — Quiet window tomorrow 2026-03-27 02:00-04:00 UTC for the canary->prod migration of inference-serving. Launch freeze will be in effect during the window. Please post any exemption requests here by EOD today. I will pin the rollback owners and the GA build.

deploy-bot: pinned build inference-server:v4.2.1 -> canary. Reserved capacity scheduled 02:15 UTC. To request a pin override use `/deploy-pin request <team> <reason>`.

tom liu: Ack. I will own rollback and be on-call from 01:30-05:00 UTC. Phone available.

alice chen: I'll run the quick smoke suite after canary warmup and report results here.

jordan: Quick question — is the embed-model quantization change part of this push? need perf baselines if yes.

maria gonzalez: Jordan — quantization change is behind a feature flag and NOT in this push. This rollout contains a runtime CVE patch and a routing fix only.

sre-liaison: Confirming SLO guardrails: if tail latency > 300ms sustained over a 5m window during shift we abort. Escalation path: tom liu -> samir -> eng-sre.

devex: Release notes draft posted: https://internal/docs/releases/4100 — excerpt: "v4.2.1 — runtime CVE mitigation + routing fix. No model changes."

samir: Updated incident channel mapping and pager rotation. #incidents will be primary during the migration.

alice chen: Smoke results (canary warmup complete at 02:25 UTC): all green — 10/10 requests passed, p95 85ms. Logs:
```
[smoke] OK inference roundtrip 82ms
[smoke] cache hit rate 74%
```

maria gonzalez: :thumbsup: Thanks. Can everyone confirm they can be reached by phone for rollback coordination? If you don't have a number in your profile add it here.

jordan: On-call, phone is in my profile.

tom liu: Phone +1-415-555-0113. I'll trigger rollback if error rate or latency crosses thresholds.

ops-bot: rollback playbook v2 available. To execute as owner run: `/ops rollback inference-server v4.2.0` — this will alert #eng-oncall and run automated rollback steps.

maria gonzalez: Reminder: No schema or prompt changes during freeze. For emergency fixes, label as HOTFIX and get approvals from one infra approver + one product approver before merging.

devex: Small tooling note — preferred pin command for future windows: `/deploy-pin set inference-server v4.2.1 --window 2026-03-27T02:00Z` (creates a sticky pin for the window).

sre-liaison: I'll be monitoring dashboards and will post minute-by-minute updates if anything deviates.

maria gonzalez: Thanks everyone — closing thread for now. If an exemption is required, ping me directly and include the mitigation plan and rollback owner.
